subject: Private fleet: pinning request and fallback authorization
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private fleet: pinning request and fallback authorization

Team —

BluePeak is asking for a short-term version pin on their Private deployment to avoid the auto-rollout planned in July. They cited a month-long regulatory audit starting 2028-07-12 and want a stable image for the duration. Their ask: pin to 1.14.2 and let them skip the July minor for 30 days, with a documented rollback plan and canary if we must remediate within that window.

Key constraints they listed in the initial call:
- No service interruption during US-business hours (M–F, 08:00–18:00 ET)
- Any data-plane TLS cert changes must be pre-approved by their security team
- They want an audit trail (we can provide tracelog snapshots)

I need two things by Monday EOD:
1) A short preflight checklist we can send them (I drafted one — attached).
2) Authorization of fallback options: automatic model variant fallback is not allowed; they want a controlled rollback that we can trigger. Dev — can you confirm that our private agent supports a pinned image plus an emergency rollback trigger that does a coordinated KV cache invalidate + node drain? Lauren — I need an ops schedule we can propose.

Attachment: 20280609_preflight-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Product Ops (Private Deployments)
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private fleet: pinning request and fallback authorization

Soojin —

Short answer: yes, we can implement a pinned deployment + guarded rollback. Implementation notes:
- Image pin: create a policy that sets the cluster image tag to 1.14.2 and disables auto-upgrade flag for that tenant for 30 days.
- Emergency rollback: we have a coordinated sequence (rollback-playbook_v3.md attached):
  1) Open maintenance lock in control plane (write-only mode for config changes).
  2) Signal all inference nodes to flush KV caches and checkpoint current cache state to object store.
  3) Drain traffic from the canary pool and spin up nodes on the previous image.
  4) Gradual traffic shift back to rollback nodes with perf-health gating (token latency, error-rate).
- Circuit breaker: can trigger fallback via the admin API or Console; requires a two-person confirmation if invoked outside a scheduled window.

Constraints/risks:
- If we trigger rollback after DB schema changes (none expected for the minor), we must run a compatibility migration. We'll explicitly prohibit schema changes during pin window.
- TLS cert rotation: we can stage certs but will not rotate them without BluePeak approval.

I'll link the canary schedule and propose a 2-hour nightly window for any disruptive ops (preferably 02:00–04:00 ET).

Dev

Attachment: rollback-playbook_v3.md
From: Samir Rao <ops@bluepeak.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: it-security@bluepeak.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 10:33:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private fleet: pinning request and fallback authorization

Thanks for the quick response. A few clarifications from our side:
- We agree to a 30-day pin to 1.14.2 provided we receive an ops runbook and a signed SLA amendment for emergency rollback.
- Our security team requires a 48-hour notice window for any maintenance that touches TLS, secrets, or IAM policies.
- We accept a nightly 02:00–04:00 ET disruptive window (preferred), but we need an explicit canary plan (how many users/customers, traffic %) and telemetry thresholds that will stop a rollback mid-flight.

Would you also confirm the audit trail payloads you will provide (logs, traces, who triggered actions)? We need logs retained for 180 days.

Samir Rao
Director, Platform Ops
BluePeak Finance

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Samir Rao <ops@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private fleet: pinning request and fallback authorization

Samir / team —

Proposed maintenance plan (high level):
- Window: 2028-07-13 to 2028-08-11 (30-day pin starting 2028-07-13)
- Allowed ops: configuration pin, emergency rollback, non-disruptive telemetry updates. No schema or data migrations allowed.
- Disruptive window (if required): nightly 02:00–04:00 ET only, with a 48-hour heads-up for TLS/IAM changes.
- Canary: 3-node canary (~2% traffic), run for 30 minutes, success criteria: p95 latency < 220ms, error-rate < 0.2%, no memory OOMs, and KV hit-rate within 5% of baseline.
- Fallback gating: automatic stop if any threshold trips; rollback requires two approvals (Dev + Grace or Dev + Soojin).

I've created a tentative calendar block (canary-schedule.ics attached) and a Jira ticket INF-8241 to capture sign-offs and the SLA amendment.

Next steps:
- Dev: confirm the two-person rollback API and a test run on staging by 2028-06-20.
- Grace: prepare the audit retention export (180 days) and a sample log package.
- Soojin: coordinate BluePeak signature on the SLA amendment; attach to the Jira ticket.

Lauren
Product Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: canary-schedule.ics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <ops@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 16:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private fleet: pinning request and fallback authorization

All —

I've prepared the audit export and retention statement; sample payload attached to Jira INF-8241 (link above). Summary:
- We will ship a signed ledger of all control-plane actions (user, timestamp, request body) and a snapshot of token-level latency traces for 30 days, stored in the customer's S3 with 180-day lifecycle.
- Access to export requires an internal request and will be delivered within 24 hours to BluePeak ops.

I also validated the two-person rollback flow in staging. Steps require:
1) Initiator calls POST /admin/rollback with tenant ID + reason
2) Second approver clicks the console confirmation (or POST to /admin/confirm)
3) Orchestrator runs the rollback-playbook_v3 sequence and reports every step to the audit ledger

I'll run a staged dry-run in staging on 2028-06-18. If all green, I'll add the run notes to INF-8241. Samir — once we have your signature on the SLA amendment I'll schedule the production pin.

Grace
Director, Reliability
Redwood Inference
